trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the open world, then collections and money, then the missable clean-up — and the platinum unlocks last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It plays automatically at the start of the story; there is nothing to miss — just follow the mission prompts until the cutscene ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story progression only — work through the chapter's missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter close.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Same as the other chapter trophies: finish every mission in the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale; clear the chapter's mission list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale — it unlocks once the last mission ends. Gold, so it sits above the chapter trophies.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission — play it when it appears on the map and finish it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; follow the plan the game lays out and finish it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission — it unlocks in the mission flow, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission; finish it when it comes up.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story takedown at the airport; complete the objectives and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission — clear its objectives to earn it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: it counts story, side missions, collectibles, activities and challenges. Use the in-game stats to find what is left, and save it for last — most of the 100% comes from work you do for other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — they add up fast if you drive aggressively between missions. Farm them on long highway runs or stunt jumps; the counter is in the stats menu.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side games (fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, racing, hunting and minigames). Play one of each — you do not need to win, just try it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; gold each one. Use the right weapon for each challenge and replay any you miss — there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Fly each course and finish first; learn the gates on a practice run, then go for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race events are spread across Leonida; win 20 distinct ones. Any vehicle class counts — pick the races that suit your driving.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish against Cal and outscore him. Use the best bait for the spot and keep your line steady — the challenge is a score contest, not a single catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and finish a full game. The easiest cabinets are the short ones — one completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a series of side missions; finish them in order and the last one unlocks this trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand; the final mission is the one that pops the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish 8 full strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more). This is the strand-collection trophy, so it comes naturally if you clear every stranger icon.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand; the last mission is the trigger.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points; find all 18 and meditate at each. Sweep the map region by region so none is missed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a unique animal to hunt; track it, take it down and return. It is a one-off hunt, not a repeatable one.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Finish any 3 sets — use a checklist so you know which sets are close.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the photo and tagging activity — do it at 100 distinct spots. Work through the map systematically; the counter shows your progress.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's repeatable feats (stunts, kills, driving, exploration). 50 of them, any mix — most players clear this while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside and water to break the search.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The catch is the chain: three shops in a row, same wanted level, no losing it between them. Plan a route with three close shops, keep the wanted level low, and do it in one run. If the wanted level drops, the chain resets.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovering means driving or entering a vehicle type for the first time. Variety is the key — try cars, bikes, boats, planes and trucks. The vehicle list in the menu shows what you have found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with 5 enemies close together and down all five before it ends. A crowded firefight is the best place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-chance airport moment: leave VCIA in a way the game does not schedule. It is tied to a specific story beat, so save before the airport sequence and try it there; if you miss it, reload the save.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke about the Rhino tank — get into a Rhino, or deal with one, and survive the heat. Seek one out at a military area or at a high wanted level.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole job: no alarms, no one spotting you. Go in quiet, take the goods, and leave before anyone notices. If you are detected, the attempt fails — reload and try a quieter approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. Plan the getaway before you go in — the escape is part of the trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape the wanted level. One truck, one clean getaway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map — all 52. The map tracks which areas you have been to, so sweep the corners and the islands last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 9 gangs with illegal operations; rob one operation from each. The gang list in the game tells you which ones are left.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — just sit and enjoy it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a one-chance showroom moment: drive out through the glass in the classic GTA way. It is tied to a specific story beat, so save first and reload if you do not get it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. You do not need a high score — just finish the game (the follow-through is the shot).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a partner-activity trophy — do the partnership activity the description hints at and it pops. It is a light one, not a grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Choices made (for better or worse). This tracks the choices you make; PlayStation tracks a count to 500. It is missable because some choices are one-time — make the choices when they appear and do not skip them.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try. It is a luck-flavoured trophy — a retry that works is what triggers it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a UFO-style or paranormal event in Leonida. These events are rare and tied to specific places or times, so they are easy to miss. Check the known strange spots and be there at the right moment.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle (a drive-by with a melee weapon). It has to be a melee drive-by, not a gun — line up the target and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money; launder $250,000 of them through your contacts. It adds up over the story and side jobs — keep laundering as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and more — any shop spending counts, and it totals $100,000. Big purchases (cars, properties) speed it up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida; buy all of them. Save up — garages are not cheap, so this is a late-game purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles you own or find. Any 10 count — register as you collect.
trophies.name: On the Spot
